speaker: Doctor
text: Let's start by clarifying your symptoms: are your hand tremors resting or action-based, and have you noticed any confusion, personality changes, or difficulty with daily tasks recently? Additionally, have you or your family noticed any changes in your gait or balance?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. To further evaluate his condition, could you please clarify if his tremor worsens when his hand is relaxed and supported (resting) or only when he attempts to move or hold a position (action)? Additionally, has his wife noticed any changes in his mood, such as increased anxiety or depression?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease with Early Dementia (Parkinson's Disease Dementia).

REQUEST TEST: DAT_Scan (DaTscan) to confirm dopaminergic deficit.
REQUEST IMAGES: Brain_MRI to rule out other structural causes and assess for white matter changes.
